list_active_zones.title: List active zones
list_active_zones.description: List every active zone on the account with its name and product type (serp, unblocker, browser_api, resident, static, ...). Use list_all_zones to include deleted zones and get_zone for one zone's full plan.

type.description: Zone type, e.g. serp, isp, mobile.

list_all_zones.title: List all zones
list_all_zones.description: List every zone on the account, active or deleted, with name, type and status (`active` or `deleted`). Use list_active_zones when only live zones matter.

output.description: All zones, each with name, type and status.

get_zone.title: Get zone info
get_zone.description: Get one zone's configuration: its plan (type, country, IP allocation, bandwidth), password list, permissions and creation date. Use get_zone_status for just the active/disabled state.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

get_zone_status.title: Get zone status
get_zone_status.description: Get whether a zone is active or disabled. Returns a small status object; use get_zone for the full plan and set_zone_disabled to change it.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

get_zone_passwords.title: Get zone passwords
get_zone_passwords.description: Get the proxy passwords configured on a zone. These are the credentials used for proxy and Browser API connections (`brd-customer-<id>-zone-<zone>:<password>`). Add or remove them with add_zone_passwords / remove_zone_passwords.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

get_zone_permissions.title: Get zone permissions
get_zone_permissions.description: Get the targeting permissions enabled on a zone (country, city, ASN, carrier, vip and similar). Useful before building a proxy username that targets a city or ASN.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

create_zone.title: Add a zone
create_zone.description: Create a new zone (SERP API, Web Unlocker, Browser API, residential, mobile, ISP or datacenter proxy). `plan` decides the product. Requires the Admin or Ops role and may incur charges. Returns the new zone's configuration.
create_zone.notes: Admin or Ops role only. Can incur charges.

zone_name.description: Name of the new zone (letters, digits and underscores).

plan.description: Plan object. Shapes from the reference: SERP API `{type:'unblocker', serp:true, country?, solve_captcha_disable?, custom_headers?}`; Web Unlocker `{type:'unblocker'}`; Browser API `{type:'browser_api', country?}`; Residential `{type:'resident', country?, city?, asn?, vip?, vips?, vips_type:'shared'|'domain', vip_country?, vip_country_city?, ip_alloc_preset?, domain_whitelist?}`; Mobile `{type:'resident', mobile:true, ...}`; ISP shared `{type:'static', pool_ip_type:'static_res', ips_type:'shared', country}` (add `bandwidth:'unlimited', unl_bw_tiers:'std'` for unlimited); ISP dedicated `{type:'static', pool_ip_type:'static_res', ips_type:'dedicated', bandwidth:'unlimited', unl_bw_tiers:'std', country, ips}`; Datacenter `{type:'static', pool_ip_type:'dc', ips_type:'shared'|'dedicated', ips?, country?, country_city?, domain_whitelist?}`. Country codes must be lowercase.

delete_zone.title: Remove a zone
delete_zone.description: Permanently remove a zone. Traffic through it stops immediately and it cannot be restored; use set_zone_disabled to pause a zone instead.
delete_zone.notes: The API also accepts no zone (affecting every zone); this tool requires one on purpose.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

set_zone_disabled.title: Turn a zone on or off
set_zone_disabled.description: Enable or disable a zone without deleting it. `disable: 1` turns it off, `0` turns it back on. Use delete_zone to remove it permanently.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

add_zone_passwords.title: Add zone passwords
add_zone_passwords.description: Add one or more proxy passwords to a zone, for rotating credentials without downtime. Read the current list with get_zone_passwords.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

remove_zone_passwords.title: Remove zone passwords
remove_zone_passwords.description: Remove one or more proxy passwords from a zone. Fails if it would leave the zone with no password. Clients still using a removed password lose access.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

switch_zone_failover.title: Switch automatic failover
switch_zone_failover.description: Turn automatic failover ("100% uptime") on or off for a static Datacenter/ISP zone. With it on, an IP that goes down is replaced automatically.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

list_zone_allowlisted_ips.title: List allowlisted IPs
list_zone_allowlisted_ips.description: List the client IPs allowed to connect through each zone. Returns a map of zone to IP list. Use allowlist_zone_ips to add entries.

zones.description: Comma-separated zone names to filter by. Omit (or `*`) for all zones.

allowlist_zone_ips.title: Allowlist IPs
allowlist_zone_ips.description: Add client IPs to a zone's allowlist so they may use it. Omitting `zone` applies to every zone.

zone.description: Zone name. Omit to apply the change to every zone on the account.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

remove_zone_allowlisted_ip.title: Remove allowlisted IP
remove_zone_allowlisted_ip.description: Remove an IP, range, subnet or mask from a zone's allowlist. Omitting `zone` removes it from every zone.

zone.description: Zone name. Omit to apply the change to every zone on the account.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

list_zone_denylisted_ips.title: List denylisted IPs
list_zone_denylisted_ips.description: List the client IPs blocked from each zone. Returns a map of zone to IP list. Use denylist_zone_ips to add entries.

zones.description: Comma-separated zone names to filter by. Omit (or `*`) for all zones.

denylist_zone_ips.title: Denylist IPs
denylist_zone_ips.description: Add client IPs to a zone's denylist so they are refused. Omitting `zone` applies to every zone.

zone.description: Zone name. Omit to apply the change to every zone on the account.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

remove_zone_denylisted_ip.title: Remove denylisted IP
remove_zone_denylisted_ip.description: Remove an IP, range, subnet or mask from a zone's denylist. Omitting `zone` removes it from every zone.

zone.description: Zone name. Omit to apply the change to every zone on the account.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

add_zone_domain_permission.title: Allowlist or denylist domains
add_zone_domain_permission.description: Add target domains to a zone's domain allowlist or denylist, restricting which sites the zone may reach. Remove them with remove_zone_domain_permission.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

type.description: `whitelist` for the domain allowlist, `blacklist` for the domain denylist.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

remove_zone_domain_permission.title: Remove allowlisted or denylisted domains
remove_zone_domain_permission.description: Remove target domains from a zone's domain allowlist or denylist.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

type.description: `whitelist` for the domain allowlist, `blacklist` for the domain denylist.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

get_recent_zone_ips.title: Get recent IPs attempting to use zones
get_recent_zone_ips.description: List the client IPs that recently tried to connect to your zones, including refused ones. Use it to find an IP to allowlist with allowlist_zone_ips.

zones.description: Zone name, or `*` for any of your zones.

list_zone_static_ips.title: Get zone static IPs
list_zone_static_ips.description: List the static Datacenter/ISP IPs allocated to a zone, or the count per country with `ip_per_country`. Use list_zone_route_ips for the IPs actually routable right now.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

ip_per_country.description: Set (e.g. `true`) to get the total IPs per country instead.

add_zone_static_ips.title: Add static IPs
add_zone_static_ips.description: Allocate more static Datacenter/ISP IPs to a zone, optionally in a country or city. Incurs charges. Returns the zone's IPs and the newly added ones.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

country.description: Country for the new IPs, e.g. `us`.

country_city.description: City for the new IPs, e.g. `us-chicago`.

remove_zone_static_ips.title: Remove static IPs
remove_zone_static_ips.description: Release static Datacenter/ISP IPs from a zone. Released IPs cannot be reclaimed.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

migrate_zone_static_ips.title: Migrate static IPs between zones
migrate_zone_static_ips.description: Move static Datacenter/ISP IPs from one zone to another without releasing them.

from.description: Zone the IPs move out of.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

refresh_zone_ips.title: Refresh static or dedicated residential IPs
refresh_zone_ips.description: Replace a zone's IPs with fresh ones. Pass `ips` for static Datacenter/ISP IPs or `vips` for dedicated residential gIPs; omit both to refresh every allocated IP. The old IPs are gone afterwards.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

ips.description: Static IPs to refresh. Omit to refresh all.

vips.description: Dedicated residential gIPs to refresh. Omit to refresh all.

country.description: Country for the new IPs, e.g. `us`.

country_city.description: City for the new IPs, e.g. `us-chicago`.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

remove_zone_dedicated_residential_ips.title: Remove dedicated residential IPs
remove_zone_dedicated_residential_ips.description: Release dedicated residential gIPs from a zone. Released gIPs cannot be reclaimed.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

list_zone_route_ips.title: Get available Datacenter/ISP IPs
list_zone_route_ips.description: List the Datacenter/ISP IPs currently available for routing on a zone. Returns a newline-separated text list by default, or `[{ip, country}]` JSON when `list_countries` is true.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

list_countries.description: Return a JSON array of `{ip, country}` instead of plain text.

output.description: Plain-text IP list, or an array of {ip, country}.

list_zone_route_vips.title: Get available dedicated residential IPs
list_zone_route_vips.description: List the dedicated residential gIPs available on a zone.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

count_available_ips.title: Count available Datacenter and ISP IPs
count_available_ips.description: Count how many Datacenter/ISP IPs are available to allocate, either for an existing zone's plan or for an abstract plan (e.g. dedicated IPs in the US). Use before add_zone_static_ips.

zone.description: Zone whose current plan to check.

plan.description: Abstract plan as a JSON string, e.g. `{"country":"us","ips_type":"shared"}`, `{"ips_type":"selective","country":"us","domain_whitelist":"amazon.com fb.com"}` or `{"ips_type":"shared","country_city":"us-denver","city":true}`.

get_unavailable_static_ips.title: Get static IPs with connectivity problems
get_unavailable_static_ips.description: Get the live status of static Datacenter/ISP zones and the IPs currently having connectivity problems.

list_proxies_pending_replacement.title: Get proxies pending replacement
list_proxies_pending_replacement.description: List the proxies in a zone that are scheduled for replacement, with the count and IP list per zone.

zone.description: Zone name.

output.description: Pending replacements keyed by zone (type, ips_to_replace, ips_list).

list_static_network_cities.title: List static network cities
list_static_network_cities.description: List the cities available on the static Datacenter (`dc`) or ISP (`static_res`) network in a country, for `country_city` values when allocating IPs.

list_available_countries.title: List available countries
list_available_countries.description: List the countries available per zone type (DC/ISP, shared, dedicated IP, dedicated host). Use list_country_cities for the cities inside one country.

zone_types.description: DC_shared, DC_dedicated_ip, DC_dedicated_host, ISP_shared, ISP_dedicated_ip, ISP_dedicated_host.

list_country_cities.title: List cities in a country
list_country_cities.description: List the cities Bright Data can target in a country, for city-level proxy targeting.

get_zone_bandwidth.title: Get zone bandwidth stats
get_zone_bandwidth.description: Get bandwidth usage for one zone over a date range. Use get_zone_cost for billed cost and get_account_bandwidth for every zone.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

get_account_bandwidth.title: Get bandwidth stats for all zones
get_account_bandwidth.description: Get bandwidth usage for every zone on the account over a date range.

get_zone_cost.title: Get zone cost and bandwidth
get_zone_cost.description: Get billed cost, bandwidth and usage stats for a zone over a date range; values match the Usage Overview and invoice. `to` is exclusive: use the first day of the next month to cover a full month.

zone.description: Zone name, as shown in the control panel or returned by list_active_zones.

get_balance.title: Get account balance
get_balance.description: Get the account balance: available funds, credit, prepayment and pending usage costs, in USD.

pending_costs.description: Usage costs expected on the next invoice, USD.

export_cost_breakdown.title: Export cost breakdown
export_cost_breakdown.description: Export account costs grouped by day and by a dimension (products, zones, datasets, Web Scraper APIs, collectors, domains, snapshots...), the same data as the Cost Explorer. `to` is exclusive.

filters.description: Optional filter in Bright Data's charges-structure notation.

output.description: Costs grouped by day, then by resource ID.

get_pricing_plans.title: Get pricing plans
get_pricing_plans.description: Get the account's current pricing plan and the plans available to it, with per-product USD prices. Needs an API key with Admin or Finance permission (`billing.read`).

get_domain_usage.title: Get domain usage metrics
get_domain_usage.description: Get per-target-domain usage for a date range: bandwidth (`bw`) or request count (`req`), optionally for one zone.

zones.description: Zone name filter. Omit for all zones.

get_account_status.title: Get account status
get_account_status.description: Get the account status, the customer ID, whether it can currently make requests, any auth failure reason and the caller's IP. A cheap way to check the API key works.

auth_fail_reason.description: Why auth failed, if it did.

set_account_status.title: Change account status
set_account_status.description: Suspend the account manually (`suspend_manual`) or reactivate it (`active`). A suspended account stops serving all traffic.

get_network_status.title: Get current service status
get_network_status.description: Get the current health of Bright Data's proxy networks: all, residential, datacenter or mobile.

unlock_url.title: Unlock a website (Web Unlocker)
unlock_url.description: Fetch any URL through Web Unlocker, which handles blocks, CAPTCHAs, fingerprinting and retries. `format: raw` returns the page body as text; `json` wraps status, headers and body. `data_format` can turn the page into markdown or a PNG screenshot. For search engine results use search_serp; for large batches use submit_unlocker_async.

zone.description: Name of your Web Unlocker zone (or SERP API zone for search).

format.description: `raw` returns the body as-is, `json` returns a structured envelope.

method.description: HTTP method for the target request.

country.description: 2-letter country code for the proxy location, e.g. `us`. Omit to let the zone decide.

data_format.description: `markdown` converts HTML to markdown, `screenshot` returns a PNG of the page.

render.description: `true` forces JavaScript rendering in a browser (slower). Only for JS-dependent pages.

debug.description: Return the `x-brd-debug` header with request ID, traffic and peer details.

async.description: Run asynchronously; the result is fetched later.

output.description: The page content (raw body text) or the JSON envelope, depending on `format`.

search_serp.title: Get search engine results (SERP API)
search_serp.description: Fetch a search engine results page (Google, Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, ...) through a SERP API zone. Build `url` as the engine's own search URL, e.g. `https://www.google.com/search?q=pizza&gl=us&hl=en`; append `brd_json=1` to the URL for parsed JSON results. `format: raw` returns the body as text. Use submit_serp_async for high-volume jobs.

zone.description: Name of your SERP API zone.

url.description: Search URL, e.g. `https://www.google.com/search?q=pizza`. Add `brd_json=1` for parsed JSON.

format.description: `raw` returns the body as-is, `json` returns a structured envelope.

country.description: 2-letter country code for the proxy location, e.g. `us`. Omit to let the zone decide.

data_format.description: `markdown` converts HTML to markdown, `screenshot` returns a PNG.

async.description: Run asynchronously; the result is fetched later.

output.description: The results page (HTML, or JSON when `brd_json=1`) as text, or the JSON envelope.

submit_unlocker_async.title: Submit an async Web Unlocker request
submit_unlocker_async.description: Queue a Web Unlocker request and return immediately with a `response_id` (also in the `x-response-id` header). Collect the page with get_unlocker_async_result, or get notified at `webhook_url`.

zone.description: Name of your Web Unlocker zone (or SERP API zone for search).

method.description: HTTP method of the target request.

headers.description: Headers to send to the target.

body.description: Body to send to the target (serialised to JSON).

country.description: 2-letter country code for the proxy location, e.g. `us`. Omit to let the zone decide.

webhook_url.description: URL notified when the job completes.

webhook_data.description: Data sent with the job status notification.

debug.description: Return the `x-brd-debug` header when the result is collected.

get_unlocker_async_result.title: Get async Web Unlocker result
get_unlocker_async_result.description: Collect the page for an async Web Unlocker job by `response_id`. Returns 102 while still processing; results are kept for a limited time.

zone.description: Web Unlocker zone name.

get_unlocker_success_rate.title: Get Web Unlocker success rate per domain
get_unlocker_success_rate.description: Get Web Unlocker success-rate statistics for a domain (default window: last 7 days). A wildcard such as `example.*` returns one figure per monitored top-level domain.

domain.description: Domain such as `example.com`, or a wildcard such as `example.*`.

from_datetime.description: Window start, ISO 8601 UTC date or date-time.

to_datetime.description: Window end, ISO 8601 UTC date or date-time.

url_pattern.description: Only requests whose URL contains this substring (case-insensitive).

submit_serp_async.title: Submit an async SERP request
submit_serp_async.description: Queue a Google search through a SERP API zone and return immediately with a `response_id`. Collect the results with get_serp_async_result. Use search_serp for a synchronous call.

zone.description: Name of your SERP API zone.

country.description: 2-letter country code for the proxy location, e.g. `us`. Omit to let the zone decide.

brd_json.description: Response format: `json` for parsed results or `html`.

get_serp_async_result.title: Get async SERP result
get_serp_async_result.description: Collect the results of an async SERP job by `response_id`. Returns 102 while still processing.

zone.description: SERP API zone name.

list_scrapers.title: List Web Scraper API scrapers
list_scrapers.description: List every pre-built scraper available to the account (Amazon, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Google Maps, ChatGPT and hundreds more) with its dataset ID, collection methods (`collect_by_url`, `discover_by_*`), input schema and output fields. The response is large; filter by `dataset_id` or `domain`.

domain.description: Return only scrapers for this domain, e.g. `amazon.com`.

output.description: Scrapers with id, name, domain, category, scraper_type and per-method schemas.

trigger_collection.title: Trigger a scraper collection (async)
trigger_collection.description: Start an asynchronous Web Scraper API collection for a dataset and get a `snapshot_id`. Poll get_collection_progress until `ready`, then download_snapshot or deliver_snapshot. Set `type: discover_new` with `discover_by` for discovery methods. Use scrape_sync for a few inputs returned in one call.

input.description: Input objects; fields depend on the scraper, e.g. `[{"url": "https://..."}]` or `[{"keyword": "phones"}]`. Read the scraper's `input_schema` from list_scrapers.

limit_per_input.description: Max records per input (useful for discovery).

custom_output_fields.description: Pipe-separated output fields to keep, e.g. `url|about.updated_on`.

type.description: `discover_new` to run a discovery phase first.

include_errors.description: Include an errors report with the results.

notify.description: Send a completion notification to the webhook.

endpoint.description: Webhook URL that receives the data.

auth_header.description: Authorization header sent with webhook delivery.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID to poll and download.

scrape_sync.title: Scrape synchronously
scrape_sync.description: Run a Web Scraper API scraper and get the records back in the same response (up to about a minute; longer jobs return a `snapshot_id` with 202 to poll). Best for a handful of inputs; use trigger_collection for batches.

input.description: Input objects; fields depend on the scraper, e.g. `[{"url": "https://..."}]` or `[{"keyword": "phones"}]`. Read the scraper's `input_schema` from list_scrapers.

include_errors.description: Include an errors report with the results.

output.description: The scraped records (NDJSON/CSV text, or a JSON array with format=json); or a snapshot_id on timeout.

get_collection_progress.title: Monitor collection progress
get_collection_progress.description: Get a snapshot's status: `starting`, `running`, `ready`, `failed` or `canceled`. Poll this after trigger_collection; download once `ready`.

status.description: starting, running, ready, failed or canceled.

list_snapshots.title: List snapshots
list_snapshots.description: List the collections triggered for one dataset, with status, record count and trigger details. Filter by status or date and page with `skip`/`limit`.

from_date.description: Only snapshots created after this date.

to_date.description: Only snapshots created before this date.

download_snapshot.title: Download snapshot data
download_snapshot.description: Download the records of a `ready` snapshot. Without `format` the data is NDJSON; `json` gives an array. Split large snapshots with `batch_size` + `part` (see get_snapshot_parts). Returns 202 while still building.

batch_size.description: Split into batches of this many records.

part.description: Which batch to download (from 1), with batch_size.

output.description: The records (NDJSON/CSV text or a JSON array).

get_snapshot_parts.title: Get snapshot delivery parts
get_snapshot_parts.description: Get how many parts a batched download or delivery produced. `format`, `compress` and `batch_size` must match the download/delivery call.

get_snapshot_input.title: Get snapshot input
get_snapshot_input.description: Get the inputs that were used to trigger a collection, as CSV text.

get_snapshot_log.title: Get snapshot logs
get_snapshot_log.description: Get the collection log for a snapshot, useful for diagnosing failed inputs.

cancel_snapshot.title: Cancel a collection
cancel_snapshot.description: Cancel a running collection. A canceled collection cannot be resumed; use pause_snapshot to stop it temporarily.

pause_snapshot.title: Pause a collection
pause_snapshot.description: Pause a running collection. Resume it later with resume_snapshot.

resume_snapshot.title: Resume a collection
resume_snapshot.description: Resume a collection paused with pause_snapshot.

rerun_snapshot.title: Rerun a collection
rerun_snapshot.description: Run a previous collection again with the same inputs. Returns the new snapshot ID; billed like a new run.

deliver_snapshot.title: Deliver a snapshot to storage
deliver_snapshot.description: Send a snapshot's data to S3, GCS, Pub/Sub, Azure, Alibaba OSS, SFTP, Snowflake, a webhook or email. Returns a delivery ID to track with get_delivery_status. Use download_snapshot to pull it directly.

deliver.description: Delivery target. Every shape has `type` and `filename: {template, extension}` (extension json, ndjson, jsonl, csv or parquet). By type: `s3` {bucket, credentials: {aws-access-key, aws-secret-key} or {role_arn, external_id}, region?, directory?, endpoint_url?}; `gcs` {bucket, credentials, directory?}; `gcp_pubsub` {topic_id, credentials, attributes?}; `azure` {container, credentials, directory?}; `ali_oss` {bucket, credentials, region, directory?}; `sftp` {path, port?, credentials, directory?}; `snowflake` {database, schema, stage, role, warehouse, credentials}; `webhook` {endpoint}; `email` {address}. get_delivery_destination_schema lists each type's exact fields.

batch_size.description: Records per file, to split large snapshots.

notify.description: URL notified when the delivery finishes.

get_delivery_status.title: Monitor a delivery
get_delivery_status.description: Get a delivery job's status (`done`, `canceled`, `failed`) and the files it delivered.

delivery_id.description: Delivery ID from deliver_snapshot or deliver_dataset_snapshot.

list_datasets.title: List marketplace datasets
list_datasets.description: List the Marketplace datasets available to the account with ID, name and record count. Use get_dataset_metadata for a dataset's fields.

get_dataset_metadata.title: Get dataset metadata
get_dataset_metadata.description: Get a dataset's fields with type, description and whether active/required. Read this before writing a filter for filter_dataset or search_dataset.

fields.description: Field name to {type, active, required, description}.

search_dataset.title: Search a dataset (sync)
search_dataset.description: Run a real-time Elasticsearch query against a Marketplace dataset and get up to ~1,000 records back in the response (alpha: LinkedIn people `gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0`, contact-enriched people `gd_me5ppxjr2ge6icjuh0`, companies `gd_l1vikfnt1wgvvqz95w`). Billed per record. Use filter_dataset for other datasets or bulk exports.

filter.description: Filter expression. A condition is `{name, operator, value}` with operator one of `=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `in`, `not_in`, `includes`, `not_includes`, `array_includes`, `not_array_includes`; `{name, operator: 'is_null'|'is_not_null'}`; or a group `{operator: 'and'|'or', filters: [...], combine_nested_fields?}`. Field names come from get_dataset_metadata.

filter_dataset.title: Filter a dataset into a snapshot
filter_dataset.description: Create a snapshot of the Marketplace dataset records matching a filter (billed on purchase). Returns a `snapshot_id`; poll get_dataset_snapshot until `ready`, then download_dataset_snapshot or deliver_dataset_snapshot.

filter.description: Filter expression. A condition is `{name, operator, value}` with operator one of `=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `in`, `not_in`, `includes`, `not_includes`, `array_includes`, `not_array_includes`; `{name, operator: 'is_null'|'is_not_null'}`; or a group `{operator: 'and'|'or', filters: [...], combine_nested_fields?}`. Field names come from get_dataset_metadata.

get_dataset_snapshot.title: Get dataset snapshot metadata
get_dataset_snapshot.description: Get a Marketplace snapshot's status (`scheduled`, `building`, `ready`, `failed`), record count, file size, cost and any error.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID returned by filter_dataset (or a subscription).

download_dataset_snapshot.title: Download dataset snapshot
download_dataset_snapshot.description: Download a ready Marketplace snapshot's records (default JSONL). Split large ones with `batch_size` + `part`; get_dataset_snapshot_parts says how many parts exist.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID returned by filter_dataset (or a subscription).

get_dataset_snapshot_parts.title: Get dataset snapshot parts
get_dataset_snapshot_parts.description: Get how many parts a batched Marketplace snapshot download produces. Parameters must match the download call.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID returned by filter_dataset (or a subscription).

deliver_dataset_snapshot.title: Deliver a dataset snapshot
deliver_dataset_snapshot.description: Deliver a Marketplace snapshot to cloud storage, a webhook or email. Returns a delivery ID for get_delivery_status.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID returned by filter_dataset (or a subscription).

deliver.description: Delivery target. Every shape has `type` and `filename: {template, extension}` (extension json, ndjson, jsonl, csv or parquet). By type: `s3` {bucket, credentials: {aws-access-key, aws-secret-key} or {role_arn, external_id}, region?, directory?, endpoint_url?}; `gcs` {bucket, credentials, directory?}; `gcp_pubsub` {topic_id, credentials, attributes?}; `azure` {container, credentials, directory?}; `ali_oss` {bucket, credentials, region, directory?}; `sftp` {path, port?, credentials, directory?}; `snowflake` {database, schema, stage, role, warehouse, credentials}; `webhook` {endpoint}; `email` {address}. get_delivery_destination_schema lists each type's exact fields.

list_dataset_views.title: List dataset views
list_dataset_views.description: List the account's dataset views (saved filtered subscriptions delivered on a schedule) with view ID, name and dataset.

get_view_delivery_settings.title: Get view delivery settings
get_view_delivery_settings.description: Get a dataset view's delivery configuration: destination, file naming, CSV flattening, TAR, compression and batch size.

update_view_delivery_settings.title: Update view delivery settings
update_view_delivery_settings.description: Replace a dataset view's delivery configuration. Use bulk_update_view_delivery_settings for many views.

deliver.description: Delivery target. Every shape has `type` and `filename: {template, extension}` (extension json, ndjson, jsonl, csv or parquet). By type: `s3` {bucket, credentials: {aws-access-key, aws-secret-key} or {role_arn, external_id}, region?, directory?, endpoint_url?}; `gcs` {bucket, credentials, directory?}; `gcp_pubsub` {topic_id, credentials, attributes?}; `azure` {container, credentials, directory?}; `ali_oss` {bucket, credentials, region, directory?}; `sftp` {path, port?, credentials, directory?}; `snowflake` {database, schema, stage, role, warehouse, credentials}; `webhook` {endpoint}; `email` {address}. get_delivery_destination_schema lists each type's exact fields.

filename.description: Output file naming: `{extension: json|csv|xlsx|ndjson|parquet|jsonl, template, tz_offset}`. `template` supports `{[datetime]}`.

flatten_csv.description: Flatten nested fields in CSV output.

tar.description: Bundle files into a TAR archive.

bulk_update_view_delivery_settings.title: Bulk update view delivery settings
bulk_update_view_delivery_settings.description: Apply one delivery configuration to several dataset views at once. Returns the updated view IDs.

deliver.description: Delivery target. Every shape has `type` and `filename: {template, extension}` (extension json, ndjson, jsonl, csv or parquet). By type: `s3` {bucket, credentials: {aws-access-key, aws-secret-key} or {role_arn, external_id}, region?, directory?, endpoint_url?}; `gcs` {bucket, credentials, directory?}; `gcp_pubsub` {topic_id, credentials, attributes?}; `azure` {container, credentials, directory?}; `ali_oss` {bucket, credentials, region, directory?}; `sftp` {path, port?, credentials, directory?}; `snowflake` {database, schema, stage, role, warehouse, credentials}; `webhook` {endpoint}; `email` {address}. get_delivery_destination_schema lists each type's exact fields.

filename.description: Output file naming: `{extension: json|csv|xlsx|ndjson|parquet|jsonl, template, tz_offset}`. `template` supports `{[datetime]}`.

flatten_csv.description: Flatten nested fields in CSV output.

tar.description: Bundle files into a TAR archive.

get_delivery_settings_options.title: Get delivery settings options
get_delivery_settings_options.description: Get the options for configuring view delivery: supported destination types, filename templates and extensions, batch size.

get_delivery_destination_schema.title: Get delivery destination schema
get_delivery_destination_schema.description: Get the exact credentials and fields a delivery destination type needs, before calling a deliver or update-delivery tool.

list_studio_scrapers.title: List Scraper Studio scrapers
list_studio_scrapers.description: List the account's custom Scraper Studio scrapers with ID, name, status, delivery config and output schema. Pass the `id` as `collector` to the trigger tools.

delete_studio_scraper.title: Delete a Scraper Studio scraper
delete_studio_scraper.description: Delete a Scraper Studio scraper; it stops all manual, scheduled and API runs. Cannot be undone.

scraper_id.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

list_studio_jobs.title: List Scraper Studio jobs
list_studio_jobs.description: List Scraper Studio jobs in a date range, optionally for one scraper, with pagination.

trigger_studio_batch.title: Trigger a Scraper Studio batch collection
trigger_studio_batch.description: Start an asynchronous batch run of a Scraper Studio collector over many inputs. Returns a `collection_id`; fetch results with get_studio_batch_data.

collector.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

inputs.description: Input objects matching the collector's input schema, e.g. `[{"url": "https://..."}]`.

queue_next.description: `1` queues this after a running collection.

queue.description: Queue name; runs in a queue start one after another.

confirm_cancel.description: `1` cancels a running collection and runs this one instead.

notify.description: Notification config as a JSON string.

deliver.description: Request-level delivery config as a JSON string, overriding the scraper's default.

get_studio_batch_data.title: Get Scraper Studio batch data
get_studio_batch_data.description: Get the results of a batch collection. Returns 202 with a status object while running, then the records.

output.description: Records, or a status object while running.

trigger_studio_realtime.title: Trigger a Scraper Studio real-time job (async)
trigger_studio_realtime.description: Start a real-time run of a collector on one input and return a `response_id` immediately; collect with get_studio_realtime_result. Use crawl_studio_sync to wait in one call.

collector.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

input.description: One input object matching the collector's schema, e.g. `{"url": "https://..."}`.

get_studio_realtime_result.title: Get Scraper Studio real-time result
get_studio_realtime_result.description: Get the result of a real-time job by `response_id`; 202 while running. `timeout` long-polls up to 50s.

crawl_studio_sync.title: Run a Scraper Studio real-time job (sync)
crawl_studio_sync.description: Run a collector on one input and wait for the data (25-50s). If not done in time it returns 202 with a `response_id` for get_studio_realtime_result.

collector.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

input.description: One input object matching the collector's schema.

get_studio_job_data.title: Get Scraper Studio job data
get_studio_job_data.description: Get a Scraper Studio job's metadata and status by job ID.

job_id.description: Scraper Studio job ID, from list_studio_jobs.

get_studio_job_errors.title: Get Scraper Studio job errors
get_studio_job_errors.description: List errors produced by a batch job; `skip_normalize` returns full raw error details.

job_id.description: Scraper Studio job ID, from list_studio_jobs.

cancel_studio_job.title: Cancel a Scraper Studio job
cancel_studio_job.description: Cancel a running Scraper Studio job. Permanent: a canceled job cannot be resumed.

job_id.description: Scraper Studio job ID, from list_studio_jobs.

pause_studio_job.title: Pause a Scraper Studio job
pause_studio_job.description: Pause a running Scraper Studio job; resume it with resume_studio_job.

job_id.description: Scraper Studio job ID, from list_studio_jobs.

resume_studio_job.title: Resume a Scraper Studio job
resume_studio_job.description: Resume a paused Scraper Studio job; it moves back to `running`.

job_id.description: Scraper Studio job ID, from list_studio_jobs.

rerun_studio_job.title: Rerun a Scraper Studio job
rerun_studio_job.description: Start a new run from an existing job: the whole job, or only failed steps with `failed_only: 1`. Only jobs whose data has not expired can be rerun.

job_id.description: Scraper Studio job ID, from list_studio_jobs.

create_studio_scraper_template.title: Create a Scraper Studio scraper template
create_studio_scraper_template.description: Create a new Scraper Studio scraper with a sample template, the first step of the AI flow. Then call trigger_studio_ai_flow with its collector ID to generate the code.

deliver.description: Delivery target. Every shape has `type` and `filename: {template, extension}` (extension json, ndjson, jsonl, csv or parquet). By type: `s3` {bucket, credentials: {aws-access-key, aws-secret-key} or {role_arn, external_id}, region?, directory?, endpoint_url?}; `gcs` {bucket, credentials, directory?}; `gcp_pubsub` {topic_id, credentials, attributes?}; `azure` {container, credentials, directory?}; `ali_oss` {bucket, credentials, region, directory?}; `sftp` {path, port?, credentials, directory?}; `snowflake` {database, schema, stage, role, warehouse, credentials}; `webhook` {endpoint}; `email` {address}. get_delivery_destination_schema lists each type's exact fields.

trigger_studio_ai_flow.title: Trigger the Scraper Studio AI flow
trigger_studio_ai_flow.description: Ask the AI flow to generate working scraper code for a collector from a description and example URLs. Track it with get_studio_ai_flow_progress.

collector_id.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

get_studio_ai_flow_progress.title: Get AI flow progress
get_studio_ai_flow_progress.description: Get the progress of the AI flow job generating a collector's code.

collector_id.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

trigger_studio_self_healing.title: Trigger Self-Healing
trigger_studio_self_healing.description: Ask the self-healing tool to refactor a broken or outdated scraper template from a prompt. Track it with get_studio_self_healing_progress.

collector_id.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

prompt.description: What to fix or change (max 1000 chars).

get_studio_self_healing_progress.title: Get Self-Healing job progress
get_studio_self_healing_progress.description: Get a self-healing job's progress. `status: pending_answer` with `step: user_approval` means it waits for resume_studio_self_healing_job.

collector_id.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

resume_studio_self_healing_job.title: Approve or reject a Self-Healing job
resume_studio_self_healing_job.description: Approve (`message: true`) or reject (`false`) the diff a paused self-healing job proposes. `auto_save` saves the template once the approved job succeeds.

collector_id.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

message.description: `true` approves the diff, `false` rejects it and ends the job.

auto_save.description: Save the template automatically after success.

output.description: The provider's acknowledgement of the change (an empty body or a small status object).

enable_studio_auto_self_healing.title: Enable Auto Self-Healing
enable_studio_auto_self_healing.description: Configure Auto Self-Healing for a scraper: when the success rate falls below `sr_threshold`, a free healing job starts. Can be called once per scraper, so send `enabled: false` to save it off.

collector.description: Scraper Studio collector ID (starts with `c_`), from list_studio_scrapers.

enabled.description: Turn Auto Self-Healing on or off.

sr_threshold.description: Success-rate percentage below which healing triggers (1-70).

trigger_frequency.description: Check once a day or on every job.

min_inputs_threshold.description: Min job inputs before triggering (>=10; required for per_job).

auto_save.description: Save healed code to production without review.

max_jobs_per_day.description: Max healing jobs per day (1-24, default 8).

search_web_archive.title: Search the Web Archive
search_web_archive.description: Search Bright Data's archive of collected web pages. Returns a `search_id` (or the full result if done within 30s) with file count and estimated dump cost; poll get_web_archive_search, then create_web_archive_dump.

filters.description: Filters; must include a time range: `max_age` (e.g. `24h`, `7d`, `3mo`, `1y`) or both `min_date` and `max_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: domain_whitelist/blacklist, domain_regex_whitelist/blacklist, domain_like_whitelist/blacklist, url_regex_whitelist/blacklist, url_like_whitelist/blacklist, category_whitelist/blacklist (e.g. `News`, `Shopping`), language_whitelist/blacklist (ISO 639-3), ip_country_whitelist/blacklist, captcha, robots_block.

output.description: Search ID, or the completed search.

get_web_archive_search.title: Get Web Archive search status
get_web_archive_search.description: Get a Web Archive search's status (`in_progress`, `done`, `failed`) with matching file count, estimated batches, size and dump cost.

list_web_archive_searches.title: List Web Archive searches
list_web_archive_searches.description: List all current Web Archive searches with status and metadata.

create_web_archive_dump.title: Deliver a Web Archive snapshot
create_web_archive_dump.description: Deliver the files of a completed Web Archive search to S3, Azure, GCP or a webhook. Incurs the cost estimated by the search. Returns a `dump_id` for get_web_archive_dump.

delivery.description: `{strategy: 's3'|'azure'|'gcp'|'webhook', settings}`. s3 settings `{bucket, prefix?, assume_role}`; azure `{container, prefix?, credentials}`; gcp `{bucket, prefix?}`; webhook `{url, auth?}`.

get_web_archive_dump.title: Get Web Archive dump status
get_web_archive_dump.description: Get a dump's status (`in_progress`, `done`, `failed`, `canceled`), readiness percentage and batch/file upload counts.

list_web_archive_dumps.title: List Web Archive dumps
list_web_archive_dumps.description: List all Web Archive dumps with status and metadata.

list_browser_sessions.title: List Browser API sessions
list_browser_sessions.description: List Browser API (Scraping Browser) sessions with status, URLs, duration, CAPTCHA result and bandwidth. Filter by status, dates or URL; page with `offset`/`limit`.

get_browser_session.title: Get a Browser API session
get_browser_session.description: Get one Browser API session: status, target and end URLs, navigations, duration, CAPTCHA status, bandwidth and error. Get the ID from `Browser.getSessionId` over CDP or list_browser_sessions.

search_companies.title: Search companies (natural language)
search_companies.description: Search Business Search companies with a plain-language query (`instant` for fast, `smart` for more careful interpretation). Returns ranked records with match counts. Use search_companies_structured for exact field conditions.

query.description: What to find, up to 200 characters.

limit.description: Max results (instant up to 100, smart up to 10; offset+limit <= 100).

search_companies_structured.title: Search companies (structured)
search_companies_structured.description: Search Business Search companies in `ludicrous` mode with a structured query built from `and`/`or`/`not` and the field operators `equals`, `in`, `range` and `text`. Use for precise, deep pagination (offset up to 1,000); search_companies takes plain language.

search_people.title: Search people (natural language)
search_people.description: Search Business Search people with a plain-language query (`instant` for fast, `smart` for more careful interpretation). Returns ranked records with match counts. Use search_people_structured for exact field conditions.

query.description: What to find, up to 200 characters.

limit.description: Max results (instant up to 100, smart up to 10; offset+limit <= 100).

search_people_structured.title: Search people (structured)
search_people_structured.description: Search Business Search people in `ludicrous` mode with a structured query built from `and`/`or`/`not` and the field operators `equals`, `in`, `range` and `text`. Use for precise, deep pagination (offset up to 1,000); search_people takes plain language.
